instance_partition_disagreement.name: foreground-aware instance-partition disagreement
instance_partition_disagreement.pairwise_domain: for each prediction pair, U is the foreground union and C is the foreground intersection, both restricted to the fixed target ROI
instance_partition_disagreement.pairwise_score: |U minus C| / |U| + |C| / |U| * NVI(P restricted to C, Q restricted to C)
instance_partition_disagreement.nvi_normalization: VI divided by log(number of voxels in C); NVI is zero when C contains at most one voxel
instance_partition_disagreement.ensemble_aggregation: unweighted mean over all unordered prediction pairs, with a separately constructed U and C for each pair
instance_partition_disagreement.terminology: disagreement score or dissimilarity; do not call FA-IPD a mathematical metric or pure NVI

instance_matching.matching: each GT instance independently selects the highest-IoU prediction in the same anatomy; predictions may be selected by multiple GT instances
instance_matching.instance_precision: unique matched predictions / max(number of predictions, 1)
instance_matching.instance_recall: matched GT instances / max(number of GT instances, 1)
instance_matching.instance_f1: harmonic mean of instance precision and recall
instance_matching.case_aggregation: unweighted mean across GT-present anatomical groups
instance_matching.merge_error: for each prediction selected by c GT instances, add max(c-1, 0)
instance_matching.split_error: for each GT instance overlapping k>1 retained predictions, add k-1
instance_matching.cleanup_ablation: prediction cleanup disabled versus fixed 26-connectivity pruning below 1000 mm3

primary_risks.normalized_merge_split_risk: (merge errors + split errors) / max(number of GT instances in the case, 1)

h1.aurc: sort cases by uncertainty ascending; at each empirical coverage k/N use the mean risk of the retained prefix; AURC is the arithmetic mean over k=1..N; lower is better
h1.top_k_definition: highest-uncertainty ceil(k*N) cases, with deterministic case-ID tie breaking
h1.failure_event: at least one merge or split error
h1.enrichment: selected-set failure prevalence divided by full-set failure prevalence

h2.primary: normalized trapezoidal AULC of case-macro Instance F1 over budgets [40,60,80,100,120,140]; higher is better
h2.co_primary: normalized trapezoidal AULC of case-macro normalized merge-plus-split risk over the same budgets; lower is better
h2.guardrail: at matched budget, Hybrid Dice must be no more than 0.01 below the best non-structural uncertainty baseline

external_dependencies: official PENGWIN metric clarification or evaluator
